in_marathi.name: Devhita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess, divine being
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devhita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devi (Goddess) + Hita (Divine Being, Delight). Devhita represents a divine being, a goddess or a being blessed by gods. In Hindu mythology, she is believed to bring joy and happiness.
